LEI and international accounting-consolidating parents

Pro+. Uses 3 enrichment units. Daily local GLEIF Golden Copy snapshot; no upstream lookup. Linkage uses a validated Swedish organisation number registered with Bolagsverket (RA000544), never a name match. Current ACTIVE/PUBLISHED direct and ultimate accounting-consolidating relationships are separate from legal ownership; no ownership percentage is inferred. Other relationship states, including LAPSED, are retained in other_relationships. Relations and exceptions refer to canonical_lei only. All matched identities are retained; competing identities return ambiguous and no canonical parents. An empty parent list does not establish that a company has no parent; reporting_exceptions preserves source reasons. Foreign parents may have no Swedish orgnr. Starter+. A single VAT check supporting the caller's intra-EU trade. Three enrichment units per successful response, including cached results and valid:false; errors consume no units.
